sources: Fluorescent Roc (4-star Arts Unit). Skill 3 sk_wpn_funnel_0003 ("When the wielder's battle skill hits the enemy, the wielder gains ATK +{atk_up:0.0%} for {duration:0}s. Effects of the same name cannot stack."): passiveEventActions abilityEvent 302 (the wielder's damage) + CheckDamageDecorateMask (checkType 2, mask 256: battle skill) → CreateBuffAction buff_wpn_funnel_0003 on the wielder (attribute 2 formulaItem 6 = ATK %, atk_up; duration from the skill; stackingType 4: one instance, refreshed). SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_funnel_0003: atk_up 0.12 (L1) to 0.336 (L9), duration 20.
Its other effects (Will +, ATK +: cardAttributeModifier) are in the stat panel. Docs: docs/kit-batches/batch-2/chr_0023_antal.md.

buffs.label: Fluorescent Roc: ATK up (after a battle-skill hit)
buffs.note: A plain buff: a new battle-skill hit refreshes it. Created after the hit, so the hit that triggers it doesn't have it.
